aiSkills.title: AI enrichment
aiSkills.intro: Run the individual AI skills over this intake — structuring, extracting insights and generating embeddings for semantic search. Each run runs in the background.
aiSkills.structureStarted: Structuring started — this takes a moment.
aiSkills.extractDesc: Extract key insights from the answers.

aiSkills.embeddingsStarted: Generating embeddings started — this takes a moment.
aiSkills.transcribeStarted: Transcription started — this takes a moment.
aiSkills.transcribeDisabledTitle: Transcription starts from an uploaded audio source (no source overview available yet).
aiSkills.progressNote: Progress appears in the skill-run overview.

skillRunProgress.title: Nestor analyzing
skillRunProgress.body: Nestor is processing your intake. On average 90–120 seconds for an extensive intake. You may leave this tab open — we'll show the result as soon as it's ready.

nextStep.awaitingSubmissionBody: Client must fill in the intake. Send the intake link.
nextStep.analyzingBody: Nestor is analyzing your intake. This takes 90–120 seconds on average. You may leave this tab open.
nextStep.runSkillBody: The client has submitted the intake. Run the intake skill to get Nestor's analysis and suggestions.
nextStep.reviewBody: Nestor's analysis is ready. Review below and send to the client for validation.
nextStep.validationSendBody: Suggestions applied. Send the validation link to the client via email.
nextStep.waitingClientBody: Validation link sent on <0>{{date}}</0>. Waiting for client confirmation.
nextStep.contextPackRunningBody: Context Pack is being generated — Nestor bundles the validated intake into the briefing. This takes ± 60–120 seconds. You may leave this tab open.
nextStep.contextPackBody: Client has validated. Generate the Context Pack — the briefing PDF for Nestor's researcher.
nextStep.contextPackTooltip: Bundles the validated intake, sensitivities, blind spots and research questions into one PDF that feeds the research phase.
nextStep.researchStartTitle: Context Pack ready. Start the research for this intake.
nextStep.researchStartBody: This launches <0>SerpAPI + SearchAPI + Apify</0> (rag-web-browser + website-content-crawler) for every research question. Delivers 2–5 artifacts per question, ready within 2–5 minutes. Then you can manually add extra artifacts per question.
nextStep.researchConfirmBody: This starts an extensive research run for this intake. The run takes several minutes and incurs API costs. Continue?
nextStep.inResearchBody: Research running. Upload artifacts per research question or let run-research run.
nextStep.reportUploadBody: Research done. Upload the full client report (DOCX or PDF).
nextStep.resultsSendBody: Report loaded. Send the results link to the client.
nextStep.completedBody: Results link sent on <0>{{date}}</0>. Client can download via the portal.

contextPack.label: Context Pack
contextPack.intro: Briefing document for Nestor — distillation of the validated intake in 11 sections (client, decision, anchors, scope, competitors, hypotheses, …).

contextPack.generationStarted: Context Pack generation started — this takes ± 1–2 minutes.

research.panelBody: Nestor's researcher is working through the phases below. This usually takes a few minutes — you may leave this tab open.
research.completedBody: The deep research is complete. All phases have been worked through.
research.degradedBody: The deep research finished, but part of the output fell short. Open the verification report below to see exactly what was lost.
research.failedBody: The research stopped prematurely. Review the error message below and try again.
research.cancelledBody: The research was cancelled before it could finish.
research.downloadError: The download link could not be created. Please try again.
research.lockedBody: This run's audit hash chain did not verify, so the raw output is locked. Re-verify the chain to lift the lock.
research.reverifyStillBroken: The chain is still broken — the download stays locked.
research.unverifiedBody: This run has completed but the audit hash chain has not yet been checked. Verify the chain to unlock the raw output.
